name: Muille Melrose
original_name: ミュイール=メルロワーズ
source:
Star Sign: Taurus
Image Plant: Sweet Pea, Jasmine

A calm girl who likes to start conversations with people.
Shed rather cooperate than push her own ideas onto people, but those feelings she keeps to herself are stronger than anyone's.
